concept.title: Set Up a Repository
concept.shortdesc: Start working with a repository by cloning a remote one, putting your project under version control, or opening a repository you already have.

conbody.p: The Git Client always works with one active working copy, the local repository it currently operates on. There are three ways to get one:

ul.li: - Download a copy of an existing remote repository.
- Put an existing local project under version control.
- Point the Git Client at a repository already on your machine.
